basic_profile.bio: I am a 28-year-old lineman from the Midwest who recently discovered the joys of permaculture. I spend my days ensuring the electrical grid stays up and running, which can be quite demanding, but I find it rewarding. In my free time, I am getting into sustainable living practices and love sharing my experiences on Reddit. I'm single and live alone, which gives me plenty of time to tinker with my garden. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 6-9 PM local time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in electrical systems due to my career as a lineman. My interest in permaculture is relatively new, sparked by a community workshop I attended. I'm mostly self-taught, often relying on online resources and subreddits to improve my knowledge.
